chunk_map.heading: Without customer contact, agents build your guesses faster

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Referent resolution under a sequential deck read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Harm: reader cannot tell what a pronoun points at. Closest: l.4 "that something is the team's guesses" and "Agents build them" resolve in-chunk (that something = "something tells the team which build is worth making"; them = guesses); l.6 "should start there" = talking with customers every week, same sentence.
grep -nEi "(opening|earlier|previous|last) (lecture|module|slide)|said earlier" body -> 0; no pointer to another file; the only outward mention (this training, l.6) is by name, not position.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Every backward reference points at a beat that exists.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No "the X you did/saw/caught" in body. Closest l.6 "what customers did last month": customers' behavior, not a student beat.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Live-demo beats survive a text read.
rules_evaluated.na_reason: no guess/predict or demo beat in the chunk

rules_evaluated.evidence: Chunk 1 carries a self-sufficient claim in two paragraphs (l.4 mechanism, l.6 consequence); not a wait-state.

Header l.1 "Without customer contact, agents build your guesses faster" is what l.4 says ("Agents build them in days"); l.6 is the consequence for a team in that state, which the conditional header covers.

All six sub-items checked: no "Not X. Not Y. Z." (grep -c "Not .*\. Not" -> 0); no anaphora triple (closest l.6 "Book... sit in... read..." is three distinct concrete imperatives, not repeated openers); no self-grading superlative (grep -ci "most useful|best|powerful" -> 0); no number+retraction; no abstraction-noun stack; no empty-leg verb triplet (each l.6 verb names a concrete act).

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Internal dialect never lands on a slide.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Scanned for surface-as-noun, firing, compendium, forcing function, beat, mood: grep -ciE -> 0 in body. "guesses", "interviews", "support calls" are room vocabulary.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Emphasis budget — bold is for handles, and go very lightly.
rules_evaluated.evidence: grep -c "\*\*" over body l.1-6 -> 0 (maintainer-block bold excluded); within the <=1 budget.
